name: Maino Yukari
source:
A high school student one grade above Momoka and the village chief's daughter.
She's serious and courteous, often a leader among the villager's youngsters. Well aware of her own position as the village chief's daughter, she feels like she has to do her best more than anyone else.

As a result, there is no one in the surroundings who can spoil her and she secretly wants to be spoiled.

Yukari loves animals so she would like to become a veterinarian in the future. Although she doesn't hate the village, she would like to see the world outside.
